title: A worker that has lost its liveness lock is still counted as alive and as room, by everything but the refusal for cores, for up to 10 s after the loss or after it ends a job
notes: A viewer's picked audio or burnt-in subtitle can be admitted, a helper left unpreempted, or a job left for that worker, and the viewer waits the queue timeout (6 s) or the rescue when the worker never relocks. Unmeasured; none seen. The cure is counting a worker only with its lock held, as the refusal does. Promote when the dogfood's logs show a worker relocking for longer than `counted`, or a queue timeout or a late start within `counted` of a worker losing its lock; or when JS-161 or JS-164 make one of these readers decide an admission or a gauge.
